title: One of the Driving Forces
about: A thank-you to Kirstin for helping lead me toward State Arts-In and influencing who I became through years as both a participant and Assistant Director.
description: Kirstin was part of my State Arts-In story before I ever became a participant. At County Arts-In, she was one of the people who encouraged me to go, helping point me toward a program that would become an important part of my life. From my participant years through my time as an Assistant Director, I watched her set standards, keep the program moving, give people room to learn, and push us toward our best. Later, working as an AD gave me a clearer view of the planning and responsibility behind everything participants experienced. There isn't one single lesson that explains her influence. It came through years of watching, working, learning, and being trusted. This song is a thank-you for those thousands of small influences and for being one of the driving forces behind both my State Arts-In journey and the person I became.
lyrics: Verse 1
Before I ever walked those halls,
Before State Arts-In knew my name,
You were there at County Arts-In,
Helping point me toward that stage.
One of those who said, "You should go,"
And somehow that was all it took.
Then I stepped into the 4-H Building,
And found you everywhere I looked.
Pre-Chorus
Back then I knew you as the director,
The one who somehow knew it all.
Keeping everything together,
Keeping all of us on call.
Chorus
You were one of the driving forces,
Always pushing for our best.
Knowing when to let us laugh,
Knowing when we needed less.
Setting standards, giving chances,
Trusting us to learn and grow.
I couldn't see it all back then,
But looking back, I know:
You were one of the driving forces
Behind the person I would grow to be.
Verse 2
From fifteen through nineteen,
Every year you were still there.
Every day inside that building,
With a hundred things to care for.
And everybody knew the warning:
Probably best don't make you mad.
Some would swear they'd seen you angry—
They'd seen "ticked," and that was that.
Pre-Chorus
I've seen mad a time or two,
I've seen angry two or three.
If there's something past that level,
I'm quite happy not to see.
Because you never spent that anger
On every little thing gone wrong.
When something finally pushed you there,
We knew it mattered all along.
Chorus
You were one of the driving forces,
Always pushing for our best.
Knowing when to let us laugh,
Knowing when to expect our best.
Setting standards, giving chances,
Trusting us to learn and grow.
I couldn't see it all back then,
But looking back, I know:
You were one of the driving forces
Behind the person I would grow to be.
Verse 3
Then participant became AD,
And the view began to change.
The director became my boss,
Though the standards stayed the same.
I saw more of all the thinking
That went into every day,
All the work behind State Arts-In
That participants never see that way.
Pre-Chorus
It wasn't just those weeks together,
Or the shows beneath the lights.
There was thought behind the program,
Long before we all arrived.
Bridge
I couldn't name one single lesson,
Couldn't point to one advice,
One conversation or one moment
That completely changed my life.
It was years of being around you,
Years of watching how you lead.
A thousand little influences
That became a part of me.
And there's a very little list
My phone will always let come through.
Not many make it past "Do Not Disturb"—
But one of those names is you.
Because after all these years together,
If you're calling, I'll assume
There's probably a pretty good reason
I should answer pretty soon.
Final Chorus
You were one of the driving forces
Before I knew where this would lead.
You helped bring me into State Arts-In,
Then expected more from me.
From the kid inside that building
To the AD I'd come to be,
You were there through every chapter,
Helping shape a part of me.
You were one of the driving forces,
And now it's easier to see:
I came there knowing the director,
But somewhere through those years,
I learned just how much Kirstin
Had come to mean to me.
Outro
So for every year, every standard,
Every push to do things right,
For the work we never noticed
Behind every sound and light—
Thank you for the road you pointed toward,
And for believing I could be
More than who first walked into State Arts-In.
You were one of the driving forces
That helped make me... me.
